notes.title: Version 1.0.0.3 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! After a lot of work, I'm happy to announce the new version, including the following bug fixes!

* Issue when Locked cards are hidden when leaving the shop and returning to it
* Several bugs related to the card "Queen of Pentacles"
* Kardma crash fixed

Plus, there's now a new feature!

* When selecting your Seed, you can input the word "TUTORIAL" to repeat the tutorial sequence! For anyone who needs a refresher on how the game works.

Happy playing!

(Who are we kidding everyone's going to be playing Silksong now, myself included XD)

notes.title: Dev Log 2: Swinging With It!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Over the past couple of weeks, I've been hard at work on more features and polish for the game! Here's a couple of things you can expect to find in the full release of Mau²:

[h1]Shop Trade In![/h1]
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45401802/119d02e139765e4ece1f16f86df72c109d187b7b.png[/img]

In Mau², you get a lot of cash, you buy a lot of cards, and you remove cards to finetune cards. But sometimes, you wanna do both at the same time! Introducing the Trade In System!

For a slight discount, you can remove AND add a new card from the shop to your deck in one go, effectively replacing it! Of course, you're not the only one privvy to this feature, and your opponents can use it too! Expect them to have stronger and stronger decks as you venture deeper into the game, with tighter synergies and strategies!

[h1]Smooth moves![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45401802/43a3892a7c42755b1de2dfdd4648f64e99fccdd2.gif[/img]

Enjoy the smooth visuals of cards following the direction of their movement naturally! This took some work and help to get done, but I finally have it working for this game! Always good to have some juice to keep the visuals nice, no?


Alongside these, many more bug fixes, changes, and tweaks have been made! And of course... Another small surprise that you'll find out about next dev log.

See you there, and thank you for reading!
